verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability for debugging a live running web application. There is nothing about attaching a debugger, inspecting a browser or DOM, or examining network traffic. Background monitors that watch a log or port are an adjacent observation feature, and MCP servers are a generic building block; neither counts as the product itself debugging a running web app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
